name: ahrena-engineering-delivery
description: Delivery orchestrated issue→stacked-PRs: Athena, the tech-lead, plans a change, routes each concern deterministic-first — a route table, then the Clef decision gate, then a human — delegates to the build clades, runs the develop→Argos loop before each layer opens, and escalates when it is exhausted. Above her, the round method: Themis, the PM of a round, and Hermes, its Tech Lead, run a work window of Athena sessions from an approved plan to a written closing.
